login.brandLine: Hajri, workers, bills and wages in one calm place, in your own language.

owner.hint: Everything: Hajri, workers, wages, Excel import, reminders and health notes.

admin.hint: Same as the owner, for the ARQ team that sets up and looks after the app.

viewer.hint: Sees every page, can listen and ask. Can't change anything. Phone numbers masked, health notes hidden.

share.shortNotice: Namaste. For {client} on {date}, we are {count} workers short. We are arranging replacements and will update you shortly.

share.monthCount: {client}: our count for this month so far is {manDays} man-days (as of {date}). Please share your count so we can match before billing.

insights.title: Suggestions
insights.subtitle: Worked out from your own data, no guesswork
